snippet.title: Racing With My Keyboard Like It’s a Gas Pedal
snippet.description:
Test your typing speed in a whole new way!
This is a full race from Type Drivers, a fast-paced typing racing game where every keystroke pushes your car forward. Race solo or against friends, improve your typing speed, and unlock faster cars!
